Counts how often a key was pressed since the last time KeyHit asked about that same key. The count starts again from zero on every call, so the key must be released and pressed again to count another time. This is the right choice for one-shot actions like pausing or shooting, while [KeyDown](KeyDown) suits continuous movement.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local hits = 0
While Not KeyHit(1)
	If KeyHit(57) Then hits = hits + 1
	Cls
	Text 10, 10, "Press Space, Escape ends"
	Text 10, 30, "Space was pressed " + hits + " times"
	Flip
Wend
```
@param key  The scancode of the key, 1 to 255.
@param device  Only look at this keyboard, counted from 0 as in KeyboardDeviceCount. -1 (the default) means all keyboards together.
@returns How many times the key was pressed since the last call.
@gap The Device argument is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such argument and only knows one keyboard.
